title: 73.8% Smaller. Only 1.67x Faster. Why?
description:
Fewer bits reduce storage and memory bandwidth. Speed is a different question.

It depends on the complete execution path: whether the processor has suitable instructions, whether optimized kernels exist, and whether the model avoids unsupported operations and expensive conversions.

A smaller model can be faster, similar, or slower. You measure the implementation instead of predicting it.

Full measured comparison: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QB7cgfILOVI&t=3s
